verdict.rationale: Runloop's Devboxes are isolated cloud Linux sandboxes for agents (runloop-docs-1, runloop-probe-1). Agent Gateways let agents call LLM APIs without ever seeing the API keys (runloop-docs-10), and MCP Hub gives tool access without exposing credentials (runloop-docs-66). Egress network policies further limit what running code can reach (runloop-docs-58). One caveat: account secrets are injected as environment variables when configured (runloop-docs-21), so keeping credentials unreachable depends on using the gateways rather than raw secrets. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the isolation mechanism and guarantees that host or other-tenant credentials cannot be reached, independent or hands-on corroboration of the credential-hiding claims.
